summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a bundled sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync`. `math_init.js` is a ~728KB single-line obfuscator.io-style blob (string-array shuffle routine `WV8StW`, alphabet-substitution decoder `hc1jfK9`, arithmetic-string alphabet) whose actual behavior is hidden from static reading. `setup.mjs` itself is variable-name-obfuscated (`_0xXXXX` identifiers). Fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute an adjacent obfuscated JS blob during install is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: it evades Node-focused install-time scanners and runs opaque code on the installer's host on every `npm install`. This behavior has no relationship to the declared purpose of a React table component.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
